interpretation: The HYBRID-versus-HAND reversal is consistent with training-sample scale: HYBRID is worse at n=160, nearly tied at n=224, and better at n=296.
All four full296 controlled seeds favor HYBRID over HAND, so seed variance is not a sufficient explanation.
